session.summary: The user shared various ideas for future AI-related projects, including a human rights due diligence tool, working with social media influencers using AI agents, building autonomous digital life forms, creating an AI-powered second brain application, and developing a financial tracking platform called 'Follow The Fucking Money'.

records.content: Human Rights Due Diligence Tool with Dan Murphy could be developed in several ways: helping Dan structure and sell his existing data, or transforming his data into a model for AI fine-tuning. Potential collaboration with CLIM to execute this project.

details.title: Human Rights Due Diligence Tool
details.notes: This idea involves partnering with Dan Murphy to leverage existing data. Consider exploring the fine-tuning approach as it might yield higher value and uniqueness in the market.

records.content: Collaborate with Travis to scale his social media presence (currently 200k Instagram followers) by developing AI agents that function as virtual staff members. This could be developed into a marketable product or business that leverages Travis's audience and promotional capabilities.

details.title: Working with Social Media Influencers
details.notes: This approach could pioneer a new category of AI-powered influencer tools. Consider developing a prototype with Travis to demonstrate efficacy before scaling.

records.content: Develop VITA into the world's first autonomous digital life form, potentially creating an agent arena for testing and demonstration. This initiative could attract funding from early-stage investors in the AI space.

details.title: VITA Development
details.notes: The concept of autonomous digital life forms is cutting-edge and could position the team at the forefront of AI development. The agent arena idea provides a practical testing ground and demonstration platform.

records.content: Create an AI-powered second brain system, potentially using Obsidian as a front end. This addresses a significant market gap, especially as OpenAI is positioning high-end assistants at $20,000/month. The key differentiator would be the agent framework rather than just the underlying models.

details.title: AI Second Brain Development
details.notes: This project requires a compelling proof of concept to attract partners or investors. The integration with existing tools like Obsidian could accelerate adoption and provide immediate user value.

records.content: Develop 'Follow The Fucking Money' (FTFM) as an open-source platform that analyzes financial connections. This could be monetized as a Substack publication, operate as a free service using affordable models through Open Router, and allow users to contribute content. The system could visualize data connections similar to Obsidian's popular knowledge maps.

details.title: Follow The Fucking Money
details.notes: The 'Glenn Green World' approach of analyzing podcasts and revealing inconsistencies could create a compelling public record. The visualization component could be particularly appealing to users accustomed to knowledge graphs.
